entities.summary: Inna Vasylivna Ohnivets is a Ukrainian jurist and diplomat who became the ambassador to Slovakia from 2005 to 2010, and Portugal from 2015 to 2022. She currently serves as the head of Department for Ukrainians Worldwide and Humanitarian Cooperation.
